stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 266 km apart and travel towards each other at 44 km/h and 39 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 44 + 39 = 83$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{266}{83} = 3.20$ hours.
